summary.text: Tim Rogers is the Republican nominee for Wisconsin's 4th District. A Milwaukee native who works delivering gift baskets and newspapers for two local businesses, he has run for this seat in every election since 2018. His campaign website lists universal school choice, criminal justice reform, clean water and lower taxes as priorities.

paragraphs.text: Born and lives in Milwaukee, Wisconsin; graduated from North Division High School in 1978 and studied at the University of Wisconsin-Parkside and Milwaukee Area Technical College.
Works delivering gift baskets and newspapers for two local businesses, according to WUWM, which drew on his campaign website and earlier news coverage.

Ran as the Republican nominee against Gwen Moore in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024, losing each general election. In 2024 he won the Republican primary over Purnima Nath, 71.2% to 28.4%, and received 22.4% in the general election.
Said in 2024 that he made a commitment in 2018 to keep running "until we get it right."
Won the August 11, 2026 Republican primary over Purnima Nath.
